name: Balanced multiple maintenance solution with 5% dextrose

sources.citation: FDA Philippines. Product registration fields retained in the website dataset; exact formulations and current status require verification against the approved product insert. Reviewed 25 November 2026.

NICE. Intravenous fluid therapy in adults in hospital, CG174. Assessment, monitoring and maintenance principles; guidance published 2013, updated 2017. Adult guidance, not product-specific or pediatric dosing. PubMed guideline summary PMID24326887.

draft_notes: Product-specific Philippine instructions remain to be verified. No unverified composition, preservative assumption or renal replacement regimen is assigned.

revision_log.change: Faithfully attributed regulatory safety summary or descriptive guideline/registry findings; no unsupported dose or personal physician review claimed.
revision_log.approved_by: Codex source verification under existing delegated workflow.

overview.mechanism: Supplies carbohydrate and formulation-dependent electrolytes; the heading does not define tonicity or potassium content [[PHREG]].
uses: Maintenance fluid support must be matched to the verified product and assessed clinical needs [[PHREG,NICEIV]].

usual_adult_dose.dose: No universal infusion rate is inferred from this heading; verify the full electrolyte composition and use a patient-specific plan [[PHREG,NICEIV]].

monitoring: Adult IV-fluid guidance calls for reassessment of fluid status, balance charts, urea, creatinine and electrolytes, initially at least daily [[NICEIV]].

renal: The unverified electrolyte composition prevents a generic kidney-adjustment or dialysis schedule. Review the actual sodium, potassium and fluid delivery before selecting a regimen [[PHREG,NICEIV]].
pediatric: This heading includes pediatric as well as adult formulations; adult guideline principles are not a pediatric dose prescription [[PHREG,NICEIV]].

rows.design: Nine direct registrations; adult and pediatric product names.
rows.intervention: Formulations referred to reverse pages absent from the cached rows.
rows.findings: A common name and 5% dextrose do not establish identical electrolytes or interchangeable administration.
rows.limitations: The record does not establish component quantities, a complete contraindication list or equivalence to a US product.

rows.intervention: Assess needs and document an administration/monitoring plan.
rows.findings: Maintenance, replacement and resuscitation are separate decisions; reassess rather than continue a fixed prescription indefinitely.
rows.limitations: Not a trial of these Philippine products and not a pediatric/advanced-CKD dosing algorithm.
